name: National Map
description: A comprehensive portal for U.S. vector and raster geospatial datasets across multiple themes (elevation, hydrography, transportation, boundaries).

name: USGS
description: United States Geological Survey: federal science agency offering hydrology, geology, topography, remote sensing and mapping data.

name: USDA Forest Service Geodata
description: Provides vector data on forest and grassland features, biota, boundaries, environmental structures, transportation routes, and cadastral planning.

name: USDA NRCS Geospatial Data Gateway
description: Online portal for soil and conservation data, including SSURGO and other soil survey datasets at county and national scales.

name: USDA Farm Service Agency (NAIP)
description: National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP): 1-m aerial photography collected on a three-year cycle, available as county mosaics.

name: Bureau of Land Management Navigator
description: Interactive platform for public land management data, including cadastral surveys, boundaries, grazing allotments, and oil & gas wells.

name: US Fish and Wildlife Service Wetlands
description: Wetlands Mapper with data on location and condition of U.S. wetlands at a 1:24,000 scale.

name: US Census TIGER
description: Topologically Integrated Geographic Encoding and Referencing system: boundaries, roads, railroads, water features, and demographic statistics.

name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
description: Flood hazard zones, base flood elevations, high water marks, and associated structure data.

name: FEMA Geospatial Resource Center
description: FEMA GIS supports the emergency management community with world-class geospatial information, services, and technologies to prepare for, protect against, respond to, recover from and mitigate against all hazards..
tags: flooding, hurricanes, wildfires, fires, tornadoes, winter weather, radiological, earthquakes, pandemic

name: USGS Landsat Analysis Ready Data
description: Landsat satellite imagery at 30 m resolution with 16-day revisit cycle, pre-processed for analysis-ready use.

name: USGS EarthExplorer
description: Search, preview, and download USGS satellite, aerial, and digital elevation data.

name: USGS GloVis
description: Map-based browser for quickly browsing and downloading satellite imagery and aerial photography.

name: USGS Gap Analysis Project
description: Consists of mapping data layers depicting both location and conservation status of protected areas. Conservation status of common species is important for decision makers, planners, researchers and others..

name: USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD)
description: Comprehensive dataset of surface water features including lakes, ponds, streams, rivers, and man-made pipelines.

name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
description: High-resolution LIDAR and DEM data nationwide, meeting Level 2 accuracy standards for elevation analysis.

name: NOAA OneStop
description: High-resolution coastal and ocean bathymetry integrated with land topography (10 m resolution DEMs).

name: MRLC National Land Cover Database
description: 30 m resolution land cover raster dataset categorizing U.S. land into 16 classes (e.g., urban, water, forest).

name: Natural Earth
description: Public domain global vector and raster map data at multiple scales, ideal for cartographic and GIS applications.

name: OpenTopography
description: High-resolution topographic data and processing tools (LIDAR point clouds, DEMs) served in an academic portal.

name: List of GIS data sources - Wikipedia
description: Crowdsourced directory of global GIS data sources covering vector, raster, and thematic datasets.

name: Esri ArcGIS Online
description: Cloud-based GIS platform for data sharing, spatial analysis, mapping, and collaboration.

name: Minnesota Geospatial Commons
description: Statewide open data portal providing Minnesota-specific geospatial datasets from state, regional, and local agencies.

name: Minnesota DNR Data Deli
description: Department of Natural Resources portal offering GIS layers for land cover, water resources, ecological data, and wildlife habitat in Minnesota.

name: Metropolitan Council Open Data
description: Regional data portal for the Twin Cities Metropolitan Council offering GIS datasets on transportation, demographics, land use, and planning.

name: MnDOT GIS Data
description: Minnesota Department of Transportation GIS portal providing road networks, traffic volumes, crash data, and transportation planning layers.

name: eBird
description: Global avian observation database from the Cornell Lab of Ornithology, providing species occurrence data (including owl sightings) and occurrence maps accessible via download and API.

name: United States Data Sources
description: Comprehensive list of GIS data sources for everyone of the fifty states
